scope: Concept envelope model; no implemented consciousness transfer or production tolerances

components.name: Headband
components.material: PC-ABS shell with an aluminum alloy frame
components.mechanism: Holds the electrodes in position and supports the headset. It does not read consciousness.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Removable liner
components.material: Molded silicone or closed-cell foam
components.mechanism: Distributes pressure. Skin-contact materials and fit still need validation.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Crown arch
components.material: PC-ABS; nominal wall thickness: 4 mm
components.mechanism: Connects the front and rear of the headband and leaves space for wiring.
components.size: Width: 22 mm; arch apex at approximately 217 mm
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Left electrode rail
components.material: PC-ABS with compliant electrode mounts
components.mechanism: Holds four electrodes. The rail curvature has not been validated for fit.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Right electrode rail
components.material: PC-ABS with compliant electrode mounts
components.mechanism: Holds four electrodes. The rail curvature has not been validated for fit.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Left sensing electrode 1
components.material: Ag/AgCl contact placeholder with a compliant insulating mount
components.mechanism: Intended to measure local scalp potential differences. It cannot read individual neurons or complete memories.
components.size: Module diameter: 23 mm; travel and contact pressure not yet specified
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Reference and bias contacts
components.material: Surface electrodes with insulated silicone fittings
components.mechanism: Provide a reference potential and a bias connection for acquisition. They do not write information to the brain.
components.size: Two contacts, each 12 mm in diameter
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Signal cable harness
components.material: Shielded wires or flexible circuit placeholder
components.mechanism: Routes eight electrode signals to the analog front end, upstream of the wireless link.
components.size: 8 signal channels plus reference and bias
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Rear electronics enclosure
components.material: PC-ABS shell; nominal wall thickness: 2.5 mm
components.mechanism: Houses the analog front end and digital control board. The enclosure itself has no sensing function.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Analog front end and ADC board
components.material: FR-4 board with placeholder analog front end and ADC packages
components.mechanism: Amplifies and conditions the potential difference, then converts it to digital samples. Component locations are provisional.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Controller and radio board
components.material: FR-4 board with placeholder MCU, buffer and radio packages
components.mechanism: Timestamps, buffers and packages samples for wireless transmission to the dock.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Removable battery pack
components.material: Insulated housing with a placeholder protected battery pack
components.mechanism: Powers acquisition and communication only. The design excludes charging while worn.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Rear adjustment dial
components.material: Polymer knob with a placeholder adjustment mechanism
components.mechanism: Illustrates the fit adjustment. The gearing, strap length and load-bearing parts are not engineered.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Front status strip
components.material: Translucent polycarbonate with a placeholder LED board
components.mechanism: Indicates contact, recording and transmission status. It does not indicate consciousness upload progress.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Lower dock housing
components.material: PC-ABS shell and load-bearing aluminum baseplate
components.mechanism: Supports the storage and receiver modules. The headset communicates with the dock wirelessly.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Removable dock lid
components.material: PC-ABS; nominal thickness: 3 mm
components.mechanism: Covers the dock. The exploded view reveals the proposed internal layout.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Headset cradle and pads
components.material: PC-ABS with silicone pads
components.mechanism: Supports the headset when parked. The cradle does not connect to the electrodes.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Receiver and encryption board
components.material: FR-4 with placeholder processor and security chip
components.mechanism: Receives, verifies and encrypts data before local storage. This software has not been implemented.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Removable storage module
components.material: M.2 SSD form-factor placeholder with a metal carrier
components.mechanism: Intended to store encrypted EEG recordings and related files. It does not store consciousness.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Power and network ports
components.material: Insulated mounts with placeholder connectors
components.mechanism: Provide dock power and network access. Connector types have not been selected.
components.size: Ports are at the rear of the dock
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Sync status panel
components.material: Translucent cover with a placeholder LED array or display
components.mechanism: Indicates recording synchronization status. The animation illustrates the proposed data path.
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Non-slip feet and fasteners
components.material: Silicone feet with placeholder M3 fasteners
components.mechanism: Stabilize the dock on a desk. Hole positions and tolerances are not ready for production.
components.size: Four feet, each 18 mm in diameter
components.status: Design concept based on existing technology

components.name: Reserved research bay
components.material: Blank insulating cover; no consciousness-reading hardware
components.mechanism: Reserves space for future work. The design provides no method for reading a whole-brain state, encoding consciousness or preserving subjective continuity.
components.status: Unimplemented research interface; no consciousness upload function
